steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include succinylcholine chloride as of 2026-10-21.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation of succinylcholine chloride injection on 2026-07-23.
A registered plant for Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) was classified OAI after an inspection ending 2026-02-06.
The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15.
Corvale East holds 75 vials (20.5 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 106 vials (26.1 days on hand) of the 20 mg/mL, 10 mL presentation.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
